profile.headline: Senior Cloud Software Developer at Aruba, a Hewlett Packard Enterprise company
profile.summary:
Specialties
Languages: Python, C, C++, ASP.NET C#.
Concepts: Data Structure and File System, Object-Oriented Concepts, APIs, Sql and NoSql databases,
Networking Protocols: NetConf , TCP/IP, UDP, DHCP, and DNS
Tools and technologies : Docker, K8, Grafana, Bitbucket, Prometheus, Ansible, PyEz, Robot Framework, Docker, Git, Jenkins, OpenStack, Contrail, Jira
Operating System: Windows, Linux, Mac 

Interested in Software development and handling customer facing project.

positions.title: Senior Cloud Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: REST APIs · Elasticsearch · Debugging · Databases

company.name: Aruba, a Hewlett Packard Enterprise company

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developing the config generation engine to reduce time and improve the quality of common task. Use Python, Ansible, Playbook, Netconf, PyEz to develop the config generation and test engine for Juniper device, which run Junos OS.
- Developing Ansible modules and POC 
- Using juniper github and git to upload code and Ansible module

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked as a Software Developer Intern.
•	Designed, Developed, Tested and Managed Inventory Database tool which help to different team in Juniper to track and manage different product information and status.
•	Used Python, HTML 5, CSS 3.0, JavaScript, PostgreSQL, Django to developed Inventory DB tool (website) on Linux Destro(CentOS).
•	Implemented  data structure logic and Python in-built functions like list, dictionary, set etc to add additional features in Inventory DB
•	Migrated whole database in local host and perform CURD operation and run queries against the database on Linux framework

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•Worked in Asp.net C# framework 4.0, XML, Linq, Sql Server 2008, Java Script,Json,AJAX, used Testing tool like SVN for version control. 
•Troubleshooting and fixing issues related to web applications.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•Worked in Asp.net C# framework 3.5 and Sql server 2005, HTML, CSS, LINQ, JavaScript.
•Handled and solved all assigned  tasks on time and in effective manner
•And also involved in testing of different software modules by implementing waterfall model.
•Provided best support in project to resolve Kevhri Technologies’ product related  issues
•Worked cooperatively with others as a teammate to achieve results

positions.title: Trainee
positions.description: Training in ASP.NET and project on "Online Discussion Forum".

educations.schoolName: Gandhinagar Institute of Technology, Gujarat University
